title: Event Producer Consumer Profile v1
summary: A module that publishes, consumes, replays, or transforms events through queues, topics, webhooks, change streams, or realtime transports.

integration_points.name: message_schema
integration_points.description: Event payload shape, keys, timestamps, and versioning.

integration_points.name: delivery
integration_points.description: Retry, dedupe, ordering, and dead-letter behavior.

integration_points.name: consumer_operations
integration_points.description: Lag, replay, checkpoints, health, and diagnostics.

checks: Message schemas declare keys, versions, timestamps, and ordering semantics.
Delivery behavior declares retry, dedupe, and dead-letter semantics.
Producers and consumers declare ownership and compatibility expectations.
Replay or non-replay behavior is explicit.
Observability exposes failure, lag, and processing diagnostics.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for event-driven modules, webhooks, queues, CDC, and realtime messages.
Do not change message shape without compatibility notes.
Report producers, consumers, delivery semantics, and replay support.
